“In heaven’s name go down,” he threatened the little gendarme. “And make haste, or I shall put you in such a fix that never again will you go up or down, but you will remain here and rot forever beside this hole of perdition.—Is it well, comrades, that I kill him if he does not go down?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u011-r0049", "tag": "p", "text": "“It is well,” they shouted.", "sha256": "d75f8917bbd8ccef080fe5f4b911ea1c29353fe531864e78337e57933d455757", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[852]", "source_html": "

“It is well,” they shouted.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u011-r0050", "tag": "p", "text": "And Guillermo, with trembling fingers, counted out the coins he had already retrieved, and, in the throes of fear, crossing himself repeatedly and urged on by the hand-thrusts of his companions, stepped upon the bucket, sat down on it with legs wrapped about it, and was lowered away out of the light of day.", "sha256": "6976628355b8b2103cbf224ce12c2844eb80b20f0587f317c7e645178e5cfb1b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[853]", "source_html": "

And Guillermo, with trembling fingers, counted out the coins he had already retrieved, and, in the throes of fear, crossing himself repeatedly and urged on by the hand-thrusts of his companions, stepped upon the bucket, sat down on it with legs wrapped about it, and was lowered away out of the light of day.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u011-r0051", "tag": "p", "text": "“Stop!” he screamed up the shaft. “Stop! Stop! The water! I am upon it!”", "sha256": "efb4bae28d0bf444980a53c11cb44f2c5f160dafebda4c6d56818f5c04dc2264", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[854]", "source_html": "

“Stop!” he screamed up the shaft. “Stop! Stop! The water! I am upon it!”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u011-r0052", "tag": "p", "text": "Those on the sweep held it with their weight.", "sha256": "fa1ad2983ea2db6a7cbc29c27f1e3824e408181e29a54596c4a6c5e196d0d256", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[855]", "source_html": "

Those on the sweep held it with their weight.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u011-r0053", "tag": "p", "text": "“I should receive ten pesos extra above my share,” he called up.", "sha256": "2097b983ee619ded3061a89e7c21895779cef5864313c694ed7cac5085a1de26", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[856]", "source_html": "

“I should receive ten pesos extra above my share,” he called up.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u011-r0054", "tag": "p", "text": "“You shall receive baptism,” was called down to him, and, variously: “You will have your fill of water this day”; “We will let go”; “We will cut the rope”; “There will be one less with whom to share.”", "sha256": "b1d17ee27ec7bd2a5cc3503ea1c8d24e231e062c16f4e0c60d15e6f7c5c36322", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[857]", "source_html": "

“You shall receive baptism,” was called down to him, and, variously: “You will have your fill of water this day”; “We will let go”; “We will cut the rope”; “There will be one less with whom to share.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u011-r0055", "tag": "p", "text": "“The water is not nice,” he replied, his voice rising like a ghost’s out of the dark depth. “There are sick lizards, and a dead bird that stinks. And there may be snakes. It is well worth ten pesos extra what I must do.”", "sha256": "fc3702728242f4dc388325cb16adae03de1dfa6d03caf816e8a1bc8dbf36dc39", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[858]", "source_html": "

“The water is not nice,” he replied, his voice rising like a ghost’s out of the dark depth. “There are sick lizards, 92and a dead bird that stinks. And there may be snakes. It is well worth ten pesos extra what I must do.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u011-r0056", "tag": "p", "text": "“We will drown you!” Rafael shouted.", "sha256": "fbb219c5449ee7eb8274df38cd68b05509f8d985f94834aac6b4ce1cef418107", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[859]", "source_html": "

“We will drown you!” Rafael shouted.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u011-r0057", "tag": "p", "text": "“I shall shoot down upon you and kill you!” the Jefe bullied.", "sha256": "8496c51e24667c09a09bdfcf9c77a4eca6d8a56fb0abbf111df878488c6f36da", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[860]", "source_html": "

“I shall shoot down upon you and kill you!” the Jefe bullied.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u011-r0058", "tag": "p", "text": "“Shoot or drown me,” Guillermo’s voice floated up; “but it will buy you nothing, for the treasure will still be in the well.”", "sha256": "66459773d385a547074b020b49a0760b92d2e183f544f56ff8049d729916a2a3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[861]", "source_html": "

“Shoot or drown me,” Guillermo’s voice floated up; “but it will buy you nothing, for the treasure will still be in the well.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u011-r0059", "tag": "p", "text": "There was a pause, in which those at the surface questioned each other with their eyes as to what they should do.", "sha256": "bd1b31f13b83cee8b7c51831143621b2df4d62ae70c5aefb38737ad7be45e424", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[862]", "source_html": "

There was a pause, in which those at the surface questioned each other with their eyes as to what they should do.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u011-r0060", "tag": "p", "text": "“And the Gringos are running away farther and farther,” Torres fumed. “A fine discipline you have, Senor Mariano Vercara è Hijos, over your gendarmes!”", "sha256": "aa3444e3a90e5b77e7c373068d5d7faed9d1ba1c7a637b8130b8b9a09f3b5ee7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[863]", "source_html": "

“And the Gringos are running away farther and farther,” Torres fumed. “A fine discipline you have, Senor Mariano Vercara è Hijos, over your gendarmes!”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u011-r0061", "tag": "p", "text": "“This is not San Antonio,” the Jefe flared back. “This is the bush of Juchitan. My dogs are good dogs in San Antonio. In the bush they must be handled gently, else may they become wild dogs, and what then will happen to you and me?”", "sha256": "4c4170fb449afd0d3b8b2040941f322a8a579cf04ba19e708139e97baf87b502", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[864]", "source_html": "

“This is not San Antonio,” the Jefe flared back. “This is the bush of Juchitan. My dogs are good dogs in San Antonio. In the bush they must be handled gently, else may they become wild dogs, and what then will happen to you and me?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u011-r0062", "tag": "p", "text": "“It is the curse of gold,” Torres surrendered sadly. “It is almost enough to make one become a socialist, with a Gringo thus tying the hands of justice with ropes of gold.”", "sha256": "41ef2439888b9e4e6f8f6064f8efc24f9e3936beca42f563f9e8c6334f89282f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[865]", "source_html": "

“Of silver,” the Jefe corrected.
